basic_info.description: ADS8568EVM-PDK is a Texas Instruments evaluation board assembled around the onboard ADS8568. It is intended for bench evaluation of that device; the board-level specifications are not stated in the source document, which describes the onboard device rather than the assembled board.

basic_info.device_description: The ADS8568 is a 16-bit, 8-channel, simultaneous sampling analog-to-digital converter with excellent AC performance, featuring a signal-to-noise ratio of 91.5 dB and total harmonic distortion of –94 dB. It supports selectable parallel or serial interface, programmable internal reference from 0.5 V to 3.0 V, and operates over an extended industrial temperature range of –40°C to +125°C. Available in 64-pin VQFN and LQFP packages.

pin_configuration.name: BUSY/INT
pin_configuration.description: When CONFIG bit C27 = 0 (BUSY/INT), this pin is a converter busy status output. This pin transitions high when a conversion is started and transitions low for a single conversion clock cycle (tCCLK) whenever a channel pair conversion is completed and stays low when the conversion of the last channel pair completes. When bit C27 = 1 (BUSY/INT in CONFIG), this pin is an interrupt output. This pin transitions high after a conversion completes and remains high until the next read access.

pin_configuration.name: ASLEEP
pin_configuration.description: Auto-sleep enable input. When low, the device operates in normal mode. When high, the device functions in auto-sleep mode where the hold mode and the actual conversion is activated six conversion clock (tCCLK) cycles after issuing a conversion start using a CONVST_x. This mode is recommended to save power if the device runs at a lower data rate; see the Reset and Power-Down Modes section for more details.

pin_configuration.name: CONVST_A
pin_configuration.description: Conversion start of channel pair A. The rising edge of this signal initiates simultaneous conversion of analog signals at inputs CH_A[1:0]. This signal resets the internal channel state machine that causes the data output to start with conversion results of channel A0 with the next read access.

pin_configuration.description: Conversion start of channel pair B. The rising edge of this signal initiates simultaneous conversion of analog signals at inputs CH_B[1:0].

onboard_device_features: Family of 12-, 14-, and 16-Bit, Pin- and Software-Compatible ADCs

Programmable, Buffered Internal Reference: 0.5 V–2.5 V or 0.5 V–3.0 V Supports Input Voltage Ranges up to ±12 V

ko.title: ADS8568EVM-PDK 평가 보드 | ADS8568
ko.description: ADS8568EVM-PDK는 Texas Instruments에서 제작한 내장형 ADS8568을 기반으로 조립된 평가 보드입니다. 해당 장치의 벤치 평가를 위한 목적으로 설계되었으며, 보드 수준의 사양은 원본 문서에 명시되어 있지 않습니다. 문서는 조립된 보드가 아닌 내장형 장치에 대해 설명하고 있습니다.
ko.meta: ADS8568EVM-PDK는 Texas Instruments의 내장형 ADS8568을 기반으로 제작된 평가 보드입니다. 보드 수준의 사양은 원본 문서에 명시되어 있지 않으며, 평가 보드 사용자 가이드를 참조하시기 바랍니다.

de.title: ADS8568EVM-PDK-Evaluationsboard | ADS8568
de.description: ADS8568EVM-PDK ist eine Evaluationsplatine von Texas Instruments, die um den integrierten ADS8568 herum aufgebaut ist. Sie dient der Bench-Evaluation dieses Geräts; die Spezifikationen der Platine sind im Quelldokument nicht angegeben, da das Dokument das integrierte Gerät und nicht die zusammengebaute Platine beschreibt.
de.meta: ADS8568EVM-PDK ist eine Evaluationsplatine von Texas Instruments, die um den integrierten ADS8568 herum aufgebaut ist. Die Platine-Spezifikationen sind im Quelldokument nicht angegeben; siehe die Benutzeranleitung für die Evaluationsplatine.

es.title: Placa de evaluación ADS8568EVM-PDK | ADS8568
es.description: La ADS8568EVM-PDK es una placa de evaluación de Texas Instruments ensamblada alrededor del ADS8568 integrado. Está destinada a la evaluación en banco de ese dispositivo; las especificaciones a nivel de placa no se indican en el documento fuente, que describe el dispositivo integrado en lugar de la placa ensamblada.
es.meta: La ADS8568EVM-PDK es una placa de evaluación de Texas Instruments construida alrededor del ADS8568 integrado. Las especificaciones a nivel de placa no se indican en el documento fuente; consulte la guía del usuario de la placa de evaluación.
